hinge-box.part: SD card box with print-in-place hinge
assumptions: Closed box is 60 x 40 x 30 mm: base 25 mm tall plus a 5 mm lid.
Walls 2 mm, so the inside is about 56 x 36 mm, room for SD cards (32 x 24 x 2.1 mm) stacked or lying flat.
Hinge runs along the back edge: 2 mm pin, 6 mm knuckles, 0.4 mm clearance for PETG on a 0.4 mm nozzle.
Lid prints flat beside the base, 10 mm apart, opened hinge-side down.
No SD card slots or dividers unless you ask for them.
questions: Do you want the card slots or a divider inside, and how many cards does the box hold?

assumptions: Eight 20 mm cubes in a 2 by 2 by 2 arrangement (40 mm overall when folded), each cube joined to three neighbors by a hinge along a shared edge: 12 hinges.
Hinge pin 3 mm, pin bore 3.4 mm, knuckle 8 mm diameter, 8 mm long, all from the 0.4 mm nozzle and PLA defaults.
Moving gaps of 0.4 mm between knuckles and cube faces, above and below the hinge, for PLA on a 0.4 mm nozzle.
Printed flat as one plate, pieces laid out with a 10 mm gap, 0.2 mm layers.
Hinge pin diameter and knuckle size are standard fidget-cube values, not from a source.
questions: Do you want the 2 by 2 by 2 cube (40 mm folded) or a single ring of eight cubes?
Is 0.4 mm clearance right for your P1S, or do you want a looser fit?
